Daily SPF for hydrated, radiant-looking skin

Bondi Sands Face SPF 50+ Everyday Sunscreen Lotion is your daily essential for protected, healthy-looking skin. This lightweight, non-comedogenic formula layers effortlessly under makeup, won’t clog pores, and leaves skin feeling comfortable and hydrated with an invisible finish you’ll love to wear. With broad-spectrum SPF 50+ protection, it’s an easy step in your everyday skincare ritual, so you can face the day with confidence.

Always read the label and follow the directions for use. Sunscreen is only one part of sun protection. Avoid prolonged high-risk sun exposure. Re-apply frequently.
